results.title: Clocks
results.overview: A mistake made at dinner with his girlfriend, Arlo, opens some deep wounds for Marcus that may lead to the collapse of their relationship.

results.title: Picture A Tree
results.overview: Paul Graviano has molded his life and business around the art and philosophy of bonsai. Evolving a hobby and vast personal collection into a 40-year career growing and shaping miniature trees, Graviano spent time working with legendary bonsai expert Frank Okamura while volunteering at the Brooklyn Botanic Garden before founding the Bonsai of Brooklyn in 1976 – one of the oldest businesses in the U.S. dedicated to the Japanese bonsai tradition.  Now in his eighties, Graviano reflects on the landscape of memory, and a life deeply influenced by plants.

results.title: Midemdeki Delik
results.overview: In this story, which begins when the character Tarık gets into university, the disappointments he encounters are presented through a surrealist narrative. As Tarık seeks justice in the face of the university’s inadequacy, he finds that the path to a solution lies in the collective action of the students.

results.title: Jordan Klepper Fingers the Pulse: Red Flags
results.original_title: Jordan Klepper Fingers the Pulse: Red Flags
results.overview: With the 2026 midterms closing in, Republicans are facing an unpopularity crisis as gas prices skyrocket and the war in Iran drags on. In this new special, “Jordan Klepper Fingers the Pulse: Red Flags,” Klepper hits the MAGA campaign trail to see if anti-communist hysteria, God's pronouns, and old-school Islamophobia can hold the GOP's fraying coalition together.

results.title: Csavarhúzó
results.overview: A man is seen fulfilling purpose alongside the use of his tool compatriot. When their journey ends, an engulfing meaninglessness pursues and haunts them both.

results.title: Baggage
results.overview: A man on the verge of leaving home finds himself unable to let go of the life he's built behind him.

results.title: Deviant
results.overview: After a successful video date, Brooklyn invites Cameron over to her rented Airbnb in Joshua Tree to take things to the next level. Their evening soon gets interrupted by a masked intruder who takes them captive with mysterious intentions. To survive the night, they're forced to confront a sordid past that reveals a disturbing connection.

results.title: Rent: 30th Anniversary Concert
results.overview: Original cast members and a bevy of special guests revive the Tony Award- and Pulitzer Prize-winning rock musical sensation Rent in a gala concert celebration for the show’s 30th anniversary. The one-night-only concert of the full show will take place on Monday, October 26, at Broadway’s Richard Rodgers Theatre as a benefit for Broadway Cares/Equity Fights AIDS.

results.title: The Gift (Fantaisie-Impromptu)
results.overview: When ten-year-old Abigail Phillips discovers a forgotten piano deep in the woods on her father's farm, she uncovers more than a passion for music - she unlocks a mystery that spans generations. In the wake of her mother's sudden passing, Abigail finds solace and purpose in music, and her natural talent quickly blossoms. Recognizing her exceptional gift, her father sends her to Paris to pursue a career as a concert pianist. Meanwhile, he begins his own investigation into the piano's mysterious origins. As he uncovers a hidden history of loss, longing, and silent lives quietly touched by the instrument, Abigail's fame begins to grow, along with the weight of the secret behind her talent.

results.title: $$$$$$: A STAND UP COMEDY PROGRAM by The MANDAL Man
results.original_title: $$$$$$: A STAND UP COMEDY PROGRAM by The MANDAL Man
results.overview: The MANDAL Man debut half hour stand up comedy program recorded in Brooklyn, NY.

results.title: Chirp
results.overview: A woman's way of life is altered by uninvited guests.

results.title: Hermit
results.overview: A young programmer fools his boss after discovering an AI capable of doing his work in seconds, but the abundance of free time drags him into a physical transformation of Kafkaesque proportions.

results.title: Blank Slate City
results.overview: With music venue closures rising, one musician must turn to the outdoors, creating shows in unique locations to keep the music alive.

Amidst a sudden power outage at night in Lechería, Mauricio records in the dark, struggling with the frustration of flickering lights and failed phone calls. Between swearing at the darkness and trying to keep his cool, he gives an update about local pranksters pulling Halloween tricks around houses. However, the tense atmosphere quickly escalates when the lights start blinking strangely. After reviewing some video clips in the dark, Mauricio completely freaks out, ending in a chaotic meltdown of absolute panic.

results.title: Conception Game
results.overview: When single Missy (39), fresh from heartbreak and desperate to conceive, discovers a world of free sperm, she dives right in. But semen with no strings attached is scuppered when newbie Patrick (40) unwittingly breaks the rules of the game.

results.title: The Man Without Qualities
results.overview: After yet another failed review interview at the Ministry of Labor and Productivity, the visual artist Ultimo, sinks into an existential crisis. When he is ultimately declared a “marginal worker”, he embarks on a radical metamorphosis.

results.title: War Has No Children
results.overview: A documentary composed of four stories exploring what it means to be a child during war. In this environment war becomes part of everyday life, and childhood becomes fragile and vulnerable.

results.title: CORRUPTIONLAND
results.overview: CORRUPTIONLAND is a propulsive, 35-minute documentary that reveals for the first time the full extent of the rot in Trump’s Washington — and how it can be reversed.
